legal.aboutBody: Baha Ready 3D is an educational flood-preparedness game for students, residents, teachers, and MDRRMO/BDRRMC staff in Pila, Laguna and other lakeside towns. Players live through a typhoon from Signal No. 1 to No. 5: preparing the house and go-bag, evacuating through rising water, and helping neighbors. After every level, they learn what they did right and why.
legal.aboutContent: All safety content is still being verified with the MDRRMO and NDRRMC before the official launch.
legal.privacyIntro: Baha Ready 3D follows the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173). We collect as little data as possible.
legal.privacyCollect: Your email (to sign in), username, chosen avatar, language, and optional barangay and school. Game results for progress and leaderboards. No real names are ever shown publicly.
legal.privacyUse: To save your progress, show leaderboards (usernames only), and help facilitators see what their group learned. We never sell your data and there are no ads.
legal.privacyMinors: If you are under 18, let a parent or guardian know. There is no chat between users, and barangay is the most precise location we keep.
legal.privacyRights: You can export or delete your data at any time in Settings. Accounts are permanently deleted after 30 days.
legal.terms1: Baha Ready 3D is for education only. In a real emergency, follow official advisories from PAGASA, the NDRRMC, and your MDRRMO, and call 911.
legal.terms2: Don't cheat. The server checks every result and may void suspicious scores.
legal.terms3: Be respectful. Offensive usernames or ones that impersonate officials may be changed or suspended.
legal.terms4: Baha Ready 3D is free. No payments, no ads, and no in-app purchases.
